query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM entitlements e
            JOIN devices d ON d.device_type = 'kobo'
            WHERE e.book_id = $1
              AND NOT e.is_removed
              AND (
                  e.scope_type = 'ALL_USERS'
                  OR (e.scope_type = 'USER' AND d.user_id = e.scope_id)
                  OR (e.scope_type = 'DEVICE' AND d.id = e.scope_id)
              )
        ) AS "exists!"
